text: This is the last lesson of Advanced Databricks Specialization — a recap of everything this course covered, and where it leaves the wider career path you've been building toward.

Seven chapters, one production skill set: Unity Catalog at scale and Auto Loader ingestion, Lakeflow pipelines and Jobs orchestration, performance and security, and finally DP-750 prep with the capstone tying it all together.

This course was the last of five courses in the Advanced stage. Kafka, Airflow, Terraform & Bicep, and Career & Capstone were already built. Finishing this one closes the Advanced stage out completely.
And that closes out the entire path — Job Ready and Advanced, nine courses, both stages, all complete.
That's Advanced Databricks Specialization finished — and with it, the entire Databricks/Lakehouse Engineer career path. Congratulations.
